# Mirage 1.1.3

本版本新增按显示器调整壁纸画面位置、可配置的启动页和菜单栏播放列表切换，优化界面响应与资源加载，并修复场景组件自定义、文字显示及动态锁屏恢复等问题。

## 壁纸位置与操作优化

- 新增场景和视频壁纸的水平、垂直画面位置调整：在填充模式下选择被裁切方向的展示区域，位置按壁纸和显示器分别保存，并支持一键恢复居中，便于在竖屏等不同比例的显示器上调整构图（Issue #54）。
- 通用设置新增“启动时显示”，可选择“已安装”“发现”“创意工坊”或“已订阅”，保存后在下次启动 Mirage 时生效。
- 菜单栏新增播放列表“上一张”和“下一张”，多显示器下可分别操作；顺序播放按列表切换，随机播放支持回到已播放的壁纸，并保留暂停和静音状态。

## 界面响应与加载性能

- 优化壁纸库、创意工坊和下载进度的界面更新，减少无关刷新；合并重复图片请求，按展示尺寸生成缩略图，并限制并发加载，减少重复下载和解码。
- 将壁纸准备、列表筛选、属性条件计算及配置保存移至后台处理，合并连续操作并丢弃过时结果，减少快速切换、连续调参和复杂属性条件造成的界面阻塞。
- 优化开发者日志的批量写入与显示，日志窗口关闭时停止刷新显示文本，降低大量日志对界面响应的影响。

## 场景组件与渲染修复

- 修复场景组件开关及重新启用容器后的子图层可见性；改进组件位置的保存与重置，重置属性时会清除对应场景的脚本存储。
- 修复组件自定义图片与快捷方式图标的加载，支持在属性面板选择文件或文件夹作为快捷方式，并正确传递图标更新。
- 修复文字图层未应用运行时透明度的问题，避免部分壁纸开场动画结束后文字仍残留在画面上（Issue #55）。
- 改进文字字体回退：正确选择字体集合中的字形，跳过占位字体并继续查找可渲染字符，修复音乐信息等场景文字部分缺失的问题（Issue #56）。
- 保留效果显式指定的渲染目标格式，避免被 HDR 场景统一覆盖；修正部分屏幕合成效果的投影矩阵，改善相关效果的渲染兼容性。

## 动态锁屏与屏保修复

- 修复进入动态锁屏后解锁无法继续切换桌面壁纸的问题，并为屏保动态锁屏退出失败增加自动恢复重试。
- 两种动态锁屏方案的配置准备改为后台处理；原生方案先完成资源部署再切换配置，失败时保留原配置，减少设置期间的界面阻塞及配置被覆盖的问题。
- 改进原生动态锁屏的扩展升级、重复实例处理和配置确认，减少不必要的系统墙纸服务重启；设置页新增连接状态和“重试动态锁屏连接”入口。
- 修复动态锁屏快照的跨进程编码和关闭状态下的系统墙纸选项同步；关闭功能时隐藏对应选项，同时保留配置供重新开启时恢复。

## 下载

- `arm64`：Apple Silicon Mac
- `x86_64`：Intel Mac
- 应用与屏保组件要求 macOS 14.2 或更高版本；原生动态锁屏功能要求 macOS 26 或更高版本

当前构建使用临时签名，首次打开时可能需要在「系统设置 → 隐私与安全性」中选择“仍要打开”。

# Mirage 1.1.3

This release adds per-display wallpaper positioning, a configurable startup page, and menu bar playlist navigation. It also improves UI responsiveness and resource loading, and fixes Scene component customization, text rendering, and dynamic lock-screen recovery.

## Wallpaper Positioning and Navigation

- Added horizontal and vertical positioning for Scene and video wallpapers in Fill mode. Adjust the visible area along cropped axes, save positions separately for each wallpaper and display, and reset to center with one click. This makes it easier to frame wallpapers on portrait displays and other aspect ratios (Issue #54).
- Added a startup-page setting under General. Choose Installed, Discover, Workshop, or Subscribed; the saved choice takes effect the next time Mirage starts.
- Added Previous and Next playlist controls to the menu bar, with separate controls for multiple displays. Ordered playback follows the playlist, while random playback can return to previously played wallpapers. Paused and muted states are preserved.

## UI Responsiveness and Loading Performance

- Improved wallpaper library, Workshop, and download-progress updates to reduce unrelated UI refreshes. Duplicate image requests are shared, thumbnails are sized for their display area, and concurrent loading is bounded to reduce repeated downloads and decoding.
- Moved wallpaper preparation, list filtering, property-condition evaluation, and configuration saves to background workers. Consecutive operations are coalesced and stale results are discarded, reducing UI blocking during rapid switching, repeated property adjustments, and complex condition evaluation.
- Improved developer-log batching and display updates. Closing the log window stops display-text refreshes, reducing the impact of heavy logging on UI responsiveness.

## Scene Component and Rendering Fixes

- Fixed component enable toggles and child-layer visibility after re-enabling a container. Improved component-position persistence and reset behavior; resetting properties now clears the corresponding Scene script storage.
- Fixed loading of custom component images and shortcut icons. The property panel now lets users select files or folders as shortcuts and correctly forwards icon updates.
- Fixed text layers ignoring runtime opacity, preventing text from remaining on screen after some wallpapers' opening animations finish (Issue #55).
- Improved font fallback by selecting the correct face from font collections, skipping placeholder fonts, and continuing the search for renderable glyphs. This fixes missing characters in Scene text such as music information (Issue #56).
- Preserved explicitly requested effect render-target formats instead of overriding them with the Scene's HDR format, and corrected projection matrices for some screen-composited effects.

## Dynamic Lock Screen and Screen Saver Fixes

- Fixed desktop wallpaper switching becoming unavailable after unlocking from a dynamic lock screen, and added automatic recovery retries when leaving the Screen Saver Dynamic Lock Screen fails.
- Moved configuration preparation for both dynamic lock-screen modes to the background. The native mode finishes resource deployment before replacing the configuration and preserves the previous configuration on failure, reducing UI blocking and unintended configuration replacement.
- Improved native dynamic lock-screen extension upgrades, duplicate-instance handling, and configuration acknowledgement, while avoiding unnecessary wallpaper-service restarts. The settings page now shows connection status and provides a retry action.
- Fixed dynamic lock-screen snapshot encoding across processes and synchronization of system wallpaper choices when disabled. Disabling the feature hides its choices while retaining the configuration for re-enabling it later.

## Downloads

- `arm64` for Apple Silicon Mac
- `x86_64` for Intel Mac
- The app and screen-saver component require macOS 14.2 or later; native dynamic lock-screen features require macOS 26 or later

Builds use ad-hoc signing; macOS may require “Open Anyway” under System Settings → Privacy & Security on first launch.
